verdict.rationale: Brex provides official Postman collections covering all of its APIs, which users can fork. That is a machine-readable API description, a reasonable 'equivalent' to an OpenAPI spec. Its docs pages sit under /openapi/ paths, suggesting they are generated from OpenAPI, but a probe found no downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger file at the standard locations (all 404). missing for 10: a documented, downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger file, a stable spec URL, and independent confirmation that the spec can be retrieved.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
